reason: I'd let you list my nights since it's free and you load the flyers yourselves, but I'm not paying anything. My nights get filled by PR guys and WhatsApp lists, and 500 people on a waitlist is nothing next to my lists.
objection: You're a startup, will you still be around in six months? 500 signups isn't an audience, and I don't know anyone who actually opens an app to pick a club.
